name: bohrified
description: Bohrified — one launcher for the peer tutoring apps.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/app-sdk && tsc -p packages/persistence && tsc -p packages/ui && tsc -p packages/utilities && npm run typecheck -w launcher && npm run typecheck -w apps/flow
scripts.test:packages: vitest run --root packages/app-sdk && vitest run --root packages/ui
scripts.test: npm run test:flow && npm run test:launcher && npm run test:packages && npm run test:rubricable && npm run test:relay
